subject: StellarNet multi-app activation sprint and term recalibration
messages:
From: Alex Rodriguez <alex.rodriguez@stellarnet.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2028 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Requesting expansion: 3 more apps + term question

Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to onboard three additional internal apps under our existing tenant (search, recommendations, and billing insights). High level asks:

- Additional API keys for three app teams (dev/prod keys each)
- A short activation sprint targeting next month (2-week window)
- Clarify how this impacts our committed throughput and the renewal term — we were hoping to align expansion with a 12-month extension if possible (we're mid-renewal).

Can your team share a proposed rollout plan, updated cost impact, and any contract addendum required? I'll loop in procurement once we have numbers.

Alex
Product Ops, StellarNet
Attachments: StellarNet_request_summary.xlsx (ref)

From: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
To: Alex Rodriguez <alex.rodriguez@stellarnet.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Requesting expansion: 3 more apps + term question

Alex —

Thanks for the clear ask and the list of apps. We can definitely support three additional apps and provision dev/prod keypairs for each. Quick outline of next steps from our side:

1) Sales estimate & term options (Ben) — cost delta for committed throughput and short/long term pricing.
2) Onboarding runbook + sprint plan (Monica) — API key issuance, environment mapping, and small-batch rollout to apps.
3) Procurement & SOW (Rachel/Ben) — brief contract addendum to extend term + attach expanded usage.

I'll start with an internal kickoff and draft a mutual action plan. Ben — can you produce a pricing delta and one recommended term cadence (12-month extension vs. pro-rata for remaining term)? Monica — can you propose a two-week activation sprint with milestones for key issuance, smoke tests, and GA?

Target: have a costed plan + M.A.P. ready by Monday so Alex can share with procurement.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
O: +1 415-555-0192

From: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com, Alex Rodriguez <alex.rodriguez@stellarnet.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2028 12:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Requesting expansion: 3 more apps + term question

Alex / Rachel —

Appreciate the clear scope. High-level pricing notes:

- Baseline: current committed throughput covers core services; adding 3 apps with dev/prod keys will increase peak token ingest by ~35% based on your traffic samples.
- Option A (12-month extension + top-up commit): we can offer a 10% discount on incremental usage if StellarNet adds a 12-month term extension tied to a committed uplift (recommended).
- Option B (Pro-rata add-on): immediate provisioning billed at standard overage rates with the option to convert to a committed uplift later.

I'll attach a short SOW draft and an updated mutual action plan with pricing scenarios. For procurement, the SOW will call out: expected keys, key naming conventions, and a week-by-week activation acceptance matrix.

Next steps: Rachel, I recommend we present Option A as the preferred path to keep unit economics predictable for your teams; include a conversion clause if load drops below threshold. Alex, if procurement leans towards shorter extension we can finalize Option B quickly.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOW_DN-4821-draft.docx, MutualActionPlan_StellarNet.xlsx

From: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
To: Alex Rodriguez <alex.rodriguez@stellarnet.com>, rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 16 Jan 2028 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Requesting expansion: 3 more apps + term question

Alex —

Draft activation sprint (2 weeks) — proposal:

Week 1: Provisioning & dev validation
- Day 1: Issue dev/prod keypairs for search, recommendations, billing insights (6 dev + 6 prod = 12 keys).
- Day 2-3: Team-specific naming and environment mapping; provide short runbook.
- Day 4-5: Smoke tests + baseline latency/cost report.

Week 2: Staged rollout & GA
- Day 6-8: Staged rollout to 1 team at a time (search -> recommendations -> billing insights).
- Day 9: Final acceptance tests and anomaly hunt (latency, token cost).
- Day 10: GA and handover to your platform engineering.

Operational notes:
- We'll create scoped API keys that can be rotated independently.
- We recommend prefixing keys with SN_SEARCH_DEV / SN_SEARCH_PROD etc.
- For a 12-month committed uplift we can reserve burst capacity / prioritization windows during onboard sprint.

I've attached a one-page runbook and the MAP that Ben prepared. Rachel — let me know if we should propose any performance SLOs in the SOW.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: StellarNet_scope_v2.pdf

From: Alex Rodriguez <alex.rodriguez@stellarnet.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procure@stellarnet.com
Date: Mon, 16 Jan 2028 16:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Requesting expansion: 3 more apps + term question

Team —

Thanks all, this looks great and aligns with what procurement needs. Quick confirmation:

- We'll aim for the 12-month extension (Option A) pending final numbers on uplift.
- Procurement has requested the SOW + MAP and a short note on how burst capacity would be prioritized during the sprint.

Please send the draft SOW and MAP to procure@stellarnet.com and I'll schedule a procurement review for Thursday. If you can include a simple annex that shows key naming and rotation cadence, that would speed approval.

Appreciate the speedy turnaround — look forward to the docs.

Alex
Product Ops, StellarNet
Attachments received: MutualActionPlan_StellarNet.xlsx (see attachment), SOW_DN-4821-draft.docx (preview)
